target_platform: Synthetic OCI Exadata Cloud Service environment
summary: Synthetic example only. Initial review indicates that inventory and sizing information is available; compatibility and performance testing remain open.
inventory:
- Example application schemas: 12
- Example allocated data: 2.4 TB
- Example RAC source: 2 nodes
compatibility:
- Confirm target service feature support.
- Compare character sets, time zone file versions and COMPATIBLE.
- Review database options and non-default parameters.
risks:
- Example: application dependency on directory objects.
  Mitigation: inventory external files and redesign or migrate approved files.
approach: Evaluate Data Pump and RMAN-based approaches against downtime, source/target compatibility, database size and operational constraints. Final selection requires technical validation.
validation:
- Reconcile schema/object counts and row counts.
- Validate application connectivity and critical business flows.
- Compare representative workload performance.
- Obtain application-owner sign-off.
open_items:
- Confirm target shape and storage requirements.
- Confirm network bandwidth and encryption requirements.
- Agree downtime and rollback criteria.
